config.selection: Fixed4pairs per cohort/task; seven shared-training country identities (France repeated), eight excluded countries. No model-output filtering. Same wording for seen/excluded.
config.competence: Report both-endpoint accuracy and unrestricted top1 separately; fixed >=75%both/50%top1 for fourpair cohort. No failed cohort deleted.
config.limits: Countries historically evaluated elsewhere; exclusion is from this fold fitting, not model pretraining or global research. Seven vs eight unique identities and repeated France reduce independence. Related task remains in training. Paired lexical contrast, not content-independent operation proof.
